note: Nebraska Game and Parks, Area 1 on the south shore of Branched Oak Lake northwest of Lincoln; Middle Oak Creek (Area 4) is a separate entry. Paved herringbone loops on an open grassy point and the shore: the east loop's front row (sites 43-49) ends about 20 m from the water across grass and a sandy strip, and the point's outer pads are 25-60 m from the riprapped shore. A middle loop of pads between the two is not on the booking site. --Claude
summary: RA park page, 78 South Shore site records, quotes and calendars read. Confirmed 30/50-amp + 12 full-hookup sites, showers and dumps, rigs to 100 ft, open year round (FCFS through 2027-04-11, reservable from 2027-04-12, 180-day window). Quotes: Electric $25, Electric Plus $30, Full Hookup $35 for May/June 2027 nights; basic $15 stays. Lakefront confirmed on imagery (front-row sites 43-49 ~20 m from the water). Phone (402) 783-3400 missing from the entry.
flags: PHONE missing: (402) 783-3400 ('Phone Number: (402)783-3400' on the RA park page; 'Branched Oak SRA* SE 402-783-3400' on the 2025 NGPC rates grid). apply.py does not write phone - set it by hand.

WATERFRONT lakefront CONFIRMED (no change): RA tags all 78 South Shore sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' / 'Shoreline site Y' with Distance from Shoreline 50 ft (7 sites: 043-049), 200 ft (32), 300 ft (11) and 400 ft (28). Tags are claims, so checked on Esri imagery with the RA GIS points plotted: the east loop's front-row pads 043-049 are spurs pointing north off the loop road, ending ~15-20 m from a natural sandy shoreline strip and ~20-25 m from the water; nothing between but open grass and brush, the loop road is behind them. On the west point the outer pads (076-083) end 25-60 m from the riprapped shore across open grass with scattered trees, also with no road between. I see no developed swim beach or day-use facility in front of the east loop. The rest (200-400 ft) are view sites.
PIN: stored 40.95936,-96.87478 sits on the west point loop; the centroid of the 78 RA sites is 40.95948,-96.87214 (~220 m E). Under the ~250 m line; no move needed.

OTHER BRANCHED OAK ENTRIES: only 2677 (now 'Middle Oak Creek Campground', 40.97178,-96.88748). The RA page says 'Camping is permitted in nine public use areas around the lake' with 'ample space for primitive camping' and 'an area where camping is allowed with horses'; RA books only Middle Oak, South Shore and one site in Area 2 (Homestead, site 001 at 40.95890,-96.87445, inside this entry's footprint). The other seven use areas are primitive camping with no site list I could read (outdoornebraska.gov blocked) - no further developed campground found that lacks an entry; the equestrian camp would be a horse camp.

UNBOOKED LOOP: imagery shows a third herringbone loop of ~30 paved pads between the east and west booked loops (around 40.9595,-96.8715) with no RA site points. It is probably where the non-reservable sites (and the 'Basic campsites' the NGPC page names) are; not verified.

FEES left alone (human-checked 2026-10-11, no method): RA quotes 2026-11-05: site 021 Electric $25, 044 Electric Plus $30, 071 Full Hookup $35 a night for 2027-05-04 and 2027-06-15; site 021 also $25 for 2027-04-20 and 2027-10-26, so the booking site does not apply the grid's '$5 less' off-season price to those nights. Shape note: nightly_high 35 is the full-hookup price, not the base rate (schema: low/high are the base); a human may prefer low 15 / high 15 with electric +10 / full_hookup +20 surcharges like the other NE grid entries.

PULL_THROUGH (derived from earlier note prose) left alone: the RA park page lists the amenity 'Pull-through driveway' park-wide, but the South Shore pads on imagery are angled spurs off the loops (back-in style) and RA gives 'Back-In' for 18 of the 78 and nothing for the rest. Unconfirmed either way.
SAND RULE: not applicable - all South Shore pads are paved ('Driveway Surface: Paved' on all 78 RA records).
